name: Kitchen Science Quiz
description: Eleven questions about the everyday science happening in your kitchen.
author: Lullshift

help.summary: Eleven multiple-choice questions about everyday kitchen science, shown on Quick Quiz.
help.goal: Just for fun. Answer what you like; your score is shown only to you.
howToPlay: Read the question and choose an answer.
A short explanation follows each answer.
Press Next question to carry on.
At the end, Play again gives a fresh shuffle.
tips: This is for curiosity, not cooking instructions. Take care with hot things in a real kitchen.
